items.title: Recognizing Market Needs and Customer Demands (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Recognizing Market Needs and Customer Demands (PDF 132, printed 128).

blocks.text: Market ki zarooratein aur customers ki demand pehchanne ka matlab hai samajhna ke log kya chahte hain aur unhein kaun se masle hain. Entrepreneurs behtar products aur services design karne ke liye customers ka rawaiya, pasand aur trends (rujhanat) parhte hain. Surveys, feedback aur online data market mein khali jagah (gaps) dhoondne mein madad dete hain. Customers ki zarooratein achhi tarah poori karna customer ki tasalli aur business ki kamyabi laata hai. Digital economy mein online trends aur users ka feedback parakhna kamyab business khayalat ke liye bohat zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Market mein kami (gap) pehchanne ke teen tareeqe kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation: Surveys, feedback aur online data. Digital economy mein online trends aur user feedback ka analysis bohat zaroori hai.

items: Market needs: log kya chahte hain aur unhein kya masle hain.
Surveys, feedback, online data; gahak ki tasalli = karobar ki kamyabi.
